test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an economy, fisheries are a part of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__primary sector__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fisheries are the country's **single-largest agriculture export**, with a growth rate of **6 to 10 percent in the past five years.**
 
• **Primary sector** includes agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry, fishing, poultry farming, and mining.
 
• The primary sector of the economy includes any industry involved in the extraction and production of raw materials, such as farming, logging, fishing, forestry and mining.
 
• The primary sector tends to make up a larger portion of the economy in developing countries than it does in developed countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The tertiary sector__ **covers a wide range of activities from commerce to administration, transport, financial and real estate activities, business and personal services, education, health and social work.
 
• The tertiary sector is the sector of the economy that concerns services.
 
• __**The secondary sector**__ covers the manufacturing of goods in the economy, including the processing of materials produced by the primary sector.
 
• Secondary sector examples include the **plastics sector and textiles sectors.**
